note: Wooded ridges and limestone glades southeast of Danville, including the Danville Glades Natural Area. This entry is the west camping lot, a gravel lot with a privy at the end of the area road off Turkey Ridge Road; three more camping spots lie on the east side off Route RB. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' / 'Individual Campsites'; brochure: 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas shown on map... No amenities are provided', 14 days in 30. Free/FCFS/no hookups written manual; privy (map) written. Map (8/3/2022) has 4 Primitive Camping symbols: the pin's west lot (privy) off Turkey Ridge Rd, and three on the east side off Route RB (one with privy + accessible). West and east are 2.1 km apart on separate roads: split proposed for the east. Pin on the west gravel lot, fine. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites, Individual Campsites'. Brochure: 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas shown on map. These may or may not have defined campsites. No amenities are provided. Seasonal closures and restrictions may apply... Campers are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period.' Imagery: the pin lot is an open gravel lot ~35 x 25 m with cars parked on it, at the end of a gravel road; a 23-ft rig fits. CLUSTERS (4): west = pin, GIS 177/lot 203, 38.8736,-91.5350, gravel lot with privy, reached by the area road off Turkey Ridge Road; east = GIS 178/lot 1301 (38.8715,-91.5107, privy + accessible symbols, 2.1 km E), GIS 342/lot 1299 (38.8674,-91.5131, 480 m S of 178) and GIS 176/lot 1298 (38.8644,-91.5049, 900 m SE of 178, by the glade trail), all on the MDC road that runs south from the county road at Route RB, the entrance the stored directions describe.

SPLIT proposed (1): 'Danville Conservation Area - East Camping Area' at 38.8715,-91.5107 (on lot 1301; privy and accessible symbols on the map), state/MDC, same groups plus vault_toilets, phone 573-815-7900, not waterfront (small ponds only). If AWH prefers one entry, the east lot is the area's main camp (three spots, at the RB entrance) and the entry could be re-pointed there instead.
